entry here gains a fixture (delete the entry) and when an entry names a
gate the script no longer declares (the baseline outlived its gate).

label lands straight back in the missing set.

_advisory_note: Five entries below are not outstanding work. A gate declared ADVISORY exits 0 on every verdict, so no input makes it reject and the CAN-FAIL direction is unreachable by construction. Recorded here rather than silently omitted, because 'no fixture is possible' and 'no fixture was written' are different states and only one of them is work.
